name: Check DN
script:
records=frappe.db.sql("""
      SELECT 
    b.item_code AS item_code, 
    b.warehouse AS warehouse,
    
    b.actual_qty AS bin_qty,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.name) AS containers,
    SUM(c.primary_available_qty) + SUM(IFNULL(sd.reserved_qty, 0)) AS total_container_qty_avail,
    (b.actual_qty-(SUM(c.primary_available_qty) + SUM(IFNULL(sd.reserved_qty, 0)))) AS diff,
    SUM(c.primary_available_qty) AS primary_available_qty,
    SUM(IFNULL(sd.reserved_qty, 0)) AS container_reserved_qty, 
    MAX(c.modified) AS last_container_update_date
FROM 
    `tabBin` b
JOIN 
    `tabContainer` c 
    ON c.item_code = b.item_code 
    AND c.warehouse = b.warehouse
    AND c.status != "Inactive"
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT parent, SUM(reserved_qty) AS reserved_qty
    FROM `tabStock Details`
    GROUP BY parent
) sd ON sd.parent = c.name

GROUP BY 
    b.item_code, b.warehouse, b.actual_qty
HAVING 
    bin_qty != total_container_qty_avail
    AND (diff) BETWEEN -1 AND 1;
        """)

message=""
pcount=0
lcount=0
for record in records:
    if record[5]<0:
        fg_containers = frappe.db.get_list(
        "Container",
        filters={
            "item_code": record[0],
            "warehouse": record[1],
            "status": "Active",
            "primary_available_qty": (">", record[5])
        },
        fields=["name","primary_available_qty"],
        limit=1
        )
    elif record[5]>0:
        fg_containers = frappe.db.get_list(
        "Container",
        filters={
            "item_code": record[0],
            "warehouse": record[1],
            "status": "Active",
            "primary_available_qty": (">=", 0)
        },
        fields=["name","primary_available_qty"],
        limit=1
        )
    if len(fg_containers)>0:
        qty=float(fg_containers[0].primary_available_qty)+(record[5])
        message=message+record[0]+"cont:"+fg_containers[0].name+" diff: "+str(record[5])+" qty total: "+str(qty)+"\n"
        pcount=pcount+1
        container_doc=frappe.get_doc("Container",fg_containers[0].name)
        container_doc.primary_available_qty = qty
        container_doc.save()

            # ✅ Add comment
        container_doc.add_comment("Comment", "Qty :"+str((record[5]))+" is added to fix the precision issue in this container")

    else:
        lcount=lcount+1
        frappe.log_error("No existing containers for : Item : "+record[0]+" warehouse : "+record[1])

frappe.msgprint('Updated'+ str(message)+" Success: "+str(pcount)+" Loss : "+str(lcount))
